name: TEGRA
recent: Tegra 于 2026 年 10 月由 Omesti 更名为 Tegra，并在 11 月完成每 5 股合并为 1 股的反向股票分割。大股东 Datin Seri Yasmin 通过 Teguh Sedaya 持续增持，持股比例升至约 22.85%。公司最新季度营收环比下降 16.9%，但净利润环比大增 114.9%。
notable: 公司完成每 5 股现有普通股合并为 1 股的反向股票分割，合并后股份于 2026 年 11 月 19 日上市交易。
公司名称由 Omesti Berhad 更改为 Tegra Berhad，自 2026 年 10 月 20 日起生效。
大股东 Datin Seri Yasmin Hanim 通过 Teguh Sedaya Sdn Bhd 在公开市场增持股份，使其视为持股比例升至约 22.85%。
risks: 副主席 Cik Nur Atisya 在闭门期前表示有意交易公司证券，该闭门期直至 2026 年 10 月 31 日止第四季度业绩公布为止。
反向股票分割涉及每 5 股合并为 1 股，合并后不足一股的零碎股将被忽略。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日季度，营收为 3112 万令吉，环比下降 16.9%，但同比增长 77.8%；净利润为 616 万令吉，环比大增 114.9%，净利率从 7.6% 升至 19.8%。

recent_en: Tegra renamed from Omesti in October 2026 and completed a 5-into-1 share consolidation in November. Substantial shareholder Datin Seri Yasmin increased her deemed stake via Teguh Sedaya to about 22.85%. Latest quarterly revenue fell 16.9% QoQ while net profit jumped 114.9% QoQ.
notable_en: The company completed a 5-into-1 share consolidation, with consolidated shares listed on 19 November 2026.
The company changed its name from Omesti Berhad to Tegra Berhad, effective 20 October 2026.
Substantial shareholder Datin Seri Yasmin Hanim increased her deemed stake via Teguh Sedaya Sdn Bhd to about 22.85%.
risks_en: Deputy Chairman Cik Nur Atisya indicated intention to deal in company securities during the closed period pending the announcement of Q4 results ended 31 October 2026.
The share consolidation involves 5 existing shares into 1 consolidated share, with fractional entitlements disregarded.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR 31.12 million, down 16.9% QoQ but up 77.8% YoY; net profit was MYR 6.16 million, up 114.9% QoQ, with net margin rising from 7.6% to 19.8%.
